name: mattermost-jala
description: Search Mattermost messages, read channel threads, create channels, add members, and post or reply in JALA.

interface.shortDescription: Search Mattermost, read channel threads, create channels, and post in JALA.
interface.longDescription: Search messages, review channel and thread history, look up teams, users, and channel members, create channels, add users to channels, post or reply, and send yourself a direct message in JALA Mattermost. Available actions follow your Mattermost permissions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Mattermost to find and work with content in my JALA workspace.
